description: This file defines a Next.js page component for displaying detailed information about a recipe, including server-side data fetching, static generation, metadata, and rendering of recipe details, images, ingredients, and steps.

methods.name: generateStaticParams
methods.description: Fetches all recipes to generate static routes for each recipe ID.

methods.name: generateMetadata
methods.description: Fetches recipe data to generate dynamic page metadata such as title and description.

methods.name: RecipeDetail
methods.description: Main React component that fetches and displays a recipe's detailed information based on the route parameters.
